answer: Anchor each identity to one physical device: its key lives in a secure element, an ember that never leaves the chip, and signs each epoch nonce. The registry keeps a grove of manufacturer-certified device keys and rejects any duplicate key or reused counter, so one device anchors at most one identity per epoch. To forge a second identity a farm must buy another $80+ device — certificates cannot be copied or shared, and bulk buying cannot push the price below the manufacturing floor. Duplicate certificate: both identities slashed and de-established.
